coverage_scope: Published domestic, intra-regional and worldwide international routes from selected civilian airports in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Turkmenistan. Historical candidates are not current service evidence. Not complete country or airline coverage.
replay_note: Central Asia · Flights departing 2 November 2026 in each origin airport’s local time, including overnight arrivals. Timeline: UTC; airport boards use local time. New quotes use USD; reused quotes retain their original currencies. Coverage and prices are partial. Empty results mean not returned, not no service. Paths are illustrative.
collection_strategy: Sourced Central Asian airport directions, one origin-local date; reuse original captures and currencies, new USD quotes; no Cartesian airport expansion
